name: style-air
title: Air
description: The default cool blue Neumorphism UI style with balanced depth and soft controls.

light.neu-shadow-inset: inset 2px 2px 6px var(--neu-shadow-dark), inset -2px -2px 6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--neu-shadow-light) 97%, transparent)
light.neu-shadow-primary: 2px 3px 7px var(--neu-shadow-dark), -2px -2px 6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--neu-shadow-light) 94%, transparent), inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 72%, white)
light.neu-shadow-primary-inset: inset 2px 2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 68%, black), inset -2px -2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 78%, white)
light.neu-shadow-destructive-inset: inset 2px 2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--destructive) 68%, black), inset -2px -2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--destructive) 78%, white)

dark.neu-shadow-inset: inset 2px 2px 6px var(--neu-shadow-dark), inset -2px -2px 6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--neu-shadow-light) 97%, transparent)
dark.neu-shadow-primary: 2px 3px 7px var(--neu-shadow-dark), -2px -2px 6px color-mix(in srgb, var(--neu-shadow-light) 94%, transparent), inset 0 1px 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 72%, white)
dark.neu-shadow-primary-inset: inset 2px 2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 68%, black), inset -2px -2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 78%, white)
dark.neu-shadow-destructive-inset: inset 2px 2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--destructive) 68%, black), inset -2px -2px 5px color-mix(in srgb, var(--destructive) 78%, white)
